message.content:
It sounds like you want to start the Docker engine/service on Windows.  
If you’re looking to start Docker Desktop (the Docker daemon), you can do it from PowerShell or the command line:

```powershell
# PowerShell
Start-Service Docker
```

or

```cmd
# Command Prompt
net start com.docker.service
```

If you actually meant to start a specific container, you’d use:

```bash
docker start <container_name_or_id>
```

Let me know which one you need, or if you’re trying to do something else!
